settings.subtitle: Customize the look, startup, notifications and security of PC Manager Pro.

general.themeDesc: Only Dark is currently supported. Light/System coming in a future release.

startup.title: Startup with Windows
startup.subtitle: Some options require an app restart to take effect.
startup.autoLaunchDesc: PC Manager Pro will run in the background when Windows boots.
startup.minimizeToTrayDesc: Closing the main window hides the app to tray instead of quitting.
startup.checkUpdateDesc: Check GitHub Releases once per day.

notification.title: Notifications
notification.subtitle: Alerts for completed scans, updates, or detected issues.
notification.enabledDesc: Show Windows toasts when events occur.
notification.soundDesc: Requires the system notifications option above.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Restrict permissions when running the app.
security.requireAdminDesc: Some actions (SFC, DISM, system file deletion) need admin. App will warn if missing.
security.pinLockDesc: Require a 6-digit PIN to open the app. Coming in v0.2.

elevation.title: Administrator privileges
elevation.subtitle: Auto-elevate on launch so every system feature works fully.
elevation.autoElevateDesc: When enabled, the app relaunches itself with Administrator rights and shows the UAC prompt.
elevation.restartNowDesc: Restart the app right now with Administrator rights (shows the UAC prompt).

monitor.title: Realtime monitor
monitor.subtitle: Update frequency for CPU/RAM/Net and history retention.
monitor.refreshIntervalDesc: 1s is smoothest but uses more CPU; 5s saves battery.
monitor.historyRetentionDesc: After this duration, charts start overwriting old data.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: PC Manager Pro
about.description: Comprehensive Windows management & optimization, fully local, no install required.

update.title: Updates
update.subtitle: Automatic upgrades via GitHub Releases
update.upToDate: You are on the latest version
update.noNotes: No release notes for this version.
update.finished: Update complete. The app will restart automatically.
update.failed: Update failed. Please try again later.

scan.title: Virus scan
scan.customPrompt: Enter folder path to scan (e.g. C:\Users):
scan.signatureDesc: Update signatures to detect the newest malware

settings.realtimeDesc: Monitor running files/processes — when OFF, malware can run freely
settings.cloudDesc: Send metadata to Microsoft for faster analysis
settings.cloudLevelDesc: High = block on suspicion; Basic = warn first

exclusions.title: Exclusion list
exclusions.subtitle: Files/processes in this list will NOT be scanned by Defender. Only add when certain.

firewall.title: Windows Firewall
firewall.subtitle: Manage 3 profiles: Domain (corp), Private (home), Public (cafe)
firewall.noteDesc: Keep firewall ON for all 3 profiles. Turn off only temporarily for network debugging.

backup.title: Backup drivers to file
backup.subtitle: Store installed drivers for quick restore when reinstalling Windows or changing hardware
backup.requireAdminDesc: pnputil requires admin. If the app is not elevated, close and reopen with Run as administrator.
backup.step1: Before updating Windows to a new version
backup.step3: After buying new hardware that needs OEM drivers

library.profileDesc: Drivers are stored by brand and product series, shared across every machine in the same series
library.backupDesc: Automatically grouped by brand / product series. Shared drivers (Intel, NVIDIA…) go to Common.
library.libraryDesc: Pick the group matching your series to restore drivers
library.empty: No driver library yet. Run a backup to create one.
library.howToDesc: Back up once, reuse across the whole series
library.step1: Back up on one representative machine of the series (e.g. Acer Nitro 5) → saved to ACER/Nitro 5
library.step2: Drivers common to all machines (Intel, NVIDIA, Realtek) automatically go to Common/<device class>
library.step3: On a new machine of the same series, open this tab → that group is marked 'This machine'
library.step4: Click Restore → drivers are installed into Windows (requires Administrator)
